description: This Java class defines the MongoQuery implementation for querying a MongoDB database with criteria, sort options, limit, and skip parameters. It provides methods to access query components and convert sort options to BSON format.

classes.name: MongoQuery
classes.description: Immutable class implementing Query, encapsulating criteria, sort options, limit, and skip for MongoDB queries, with methods to retrieve components and generate BSON sort order.

methods.name: MongoQuery
methods.description: Constructor initializing criteria, sort options, limit, and skip with validation and immutability.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the criteria for the query.

methods.name: getSortOptions
methods.description: Returns the list of sort options.

methods.name: withCriteria
methods.description: Returns a new MongoQuery instance with updated criteria.

methods.name: getSortOptionsAsBson
methods.description: Converts the sort options into a BSON object suitable for MongoDB queries.
